en.name: Fashion Factory: Deals
en.title: Fashion Factory — Deals
en.subtitle: Compare prices, track drops
en.short_description: Compare a product's price at every store that stocks it, and get drop alerts.
en.description:
Fashion Factory answers one question well: where is this cheapest right now, and is this a good time to buy?

Search a product and the app finds its price at every store that stocks it, lays those prices side by side, and shows what the price has been doing over time. Set an alert and you hear about it the moment it drops.

—— Six categories ——

Fashion · Shoes · Bags · Perfume · Watches · Tech. One app instead of six, because the question is the same in all of them.

—— What you can do ——

COMPARE
A single table of every store carrying the product, with the real total rather than a headline price.

PRICE HISTORY
See whether today's "sale" is actually a discount or just a return to the usual price.

DROP ALERTS
Save a product and get notified when its price falls.

BROWSE AND DEALS
A curated deals feed, plus browsing by category when you do not have something specific in mind.

SAVED
Everything you are watching in one list.

—— No account needed ——

There is no sign-up and no login. Open the app and search.

—— About prices ——

Prices and availability come from retailer sources and change constantly. Fashion Factory shows you what it last saw; always confirm the final price at the retailer's own checkout before buying.

en.release_notes:
Fashion Factory 2.2.

• Compare a product's price across every store that stocks it
• Price history so you can tell a real discount from a fake one
• Drop alerts on anything you save
• Six categories: fashion, shoes, bags, perfume, watches and tech
• Curated deals feed and category browsing
• No account, no login

Feedback is welcome at contact@safecodeg.com.

review_information.notes:
2. DEVICES AND OS VERSIONS TESTED
Automated tests run on every build: iPhone 17 Pro Max and iPad Pro 13-inch simulators on iOS 26, and a Pixel Android emulator on API 34.
Each release is also installed and launched on those targets, so a
build that cannot start never ships.

3. WHAT THIS APP DOES, AND FOR WHOM
Fashion Factory answers one question well: where is this cheapest right now, and is this a good time to buy?

Intended audience:
Compare prices, track drops

4. SETTING UP AND REACHING THE MAIN FEATURES
No account and no login are required. Every feature is reachable from the first screen after launch.

5. EXTERNAL SERVICES USED
- HTTPS requests to the app's own endpoints

6. REGIONAL DIFFERENCES
The app ships 12 languages (locale 1, locale 10, locale 11, locale 12, locale 2, locale 3, locale 4, locale 5, locale 6, locale 7, locale 8, locale 9). Features are identical in every region.

7. REGULATED INDUSTRY OR THIRD-PARTY MATERIAL

The app is not in a regulated industry and carries no licensed third-party material. All content, artwork and copy are the developer's own.


ACCOUNT DELETION
The app creates no account, so there is nothing to delete.
